verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent observability and improvement platform with AI-driven features, so an MCP-client capability is a fair question, but the evidence never shows users plugging external MCP servers into Bento for it to use their tools. The only MCP mention is coding agents loading Bento's docs over MCP, which is Bento providing content to other agents (the server direction), not consuming servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
